title: An Adaptive Smoothing Algorithm for Non-Lipschitz Optimization on Manifolds with Complexity Guarantees
summary: We study a class of optimization problems on Riemannian manifolds, where the objective function consists of a smooth term and quasi-norm type penalties with exponent $p \in (0, 1]$. The essential difficulty lies in the fact that the objective function may not be locally Lipschitz continuous, which places this type of problems beyond the reach of existing Riemannian techniques. To overcome this obstacle, this paper constructs a general smoothing framework and establishes fundamental properties for developing efficient algorithms.
